annotations.title: Money Mind — Fact Check: verify a claim against sources

description: Verify a claim against 2-4 source URLs: cited passages, cross-source agreement, verdict: consistent | conflicting | insufficient_evidence. Evidence, not truth. Use when your agent needs to verify a claim against independent sources before acting on it. Give a claim plus 2-4 source URLs; each source is extracted (three-fetch cross-check, confidence-scored), the checkable figures are compared across sources, and you get the cited passages plus a verdict: con PAID: $0.03 USDC on Base via x402. Call it to receive the payment challenge. Example request: {"claim": "Acme Corp revenue was $4.2 billion in 2025", "urls": ["https://example.com", "https://example.org"]}

examples.claim: Acme Corp revenue was $4.2 billion in 2025
